scope.zh: 已核对遗址定义（五个阶段、难度、可见条件、科学家要求）、阶段事件1000–1020、第四阶段随机分派1015、掷骰失败事件9000/9005及其后续。未完成：编译器把第四阶段的三个互斥结果串成先后（见请求3）。新建为独立遗址故事（原在 event-paragon-41234 内），分类为先驱者/考古，请协调者确认归属。
scope.en: Checked the site definition (5 stages, difficulty, visibility, scientist requirement), stage events 1000–1020, the stage-4 dispatcher 1015 and the roll-failure events 9000/9005 with follow-ups. Open: the compiler chains the three exclusive stage-4 results (Request 3). Created as its own site story (was inside event-paragon-41234), category precursors/archaeology — coordinator to confirm ownership.

uncertain: The generic dig incidents (ancrel.8000–8070, 13030) on roll failure are shared hubs and are only linked.

texts.zh: [from.planet.GetName]上辽阔的冰冻荒原曾一度遍布汪洋，水面之下处处是深海火山峡谷。尽管其环境已经无法继续支持生命，我们还是在一处靠近地表的冰封堑道内发现了一些年代久远的水下定居点。
texts.en: The vast, frozen wastelands of [from.planet.GetName] were once seas, spread atop an abundance of deep volcanic canyons. Though the environment is no longer capable of supporting life, we have detected the ruins of ancient submarine settlements in icebound trenches close to the planet's surface.

sections.zh: [from.planet.GetName]上辽阔的冰冻荒原曾一度遍布汪洋，水面之下处处是深海火山峡谷。尽管其环境已经无法继续支持生命，我们还是在一处靠近地表的冰封堑道内发现了一些年代久远的水下定居点。
sections.en: The vast, frozen wastelands of [from.planet.GetName] were once seas, spread atop an abundance of deep volcanic canyons. Though the environment is no longer capable of supporting life, we have detected the ruins of ancient submarine settlements in icebound trenches close to the planet's surface.

notes.zh: 审阅说明：遗址定义带有生成权重（冰冻星球30、寒冷宜居星球5，max_instances = 1），也可在星系生成时出现；知名领袖纳苏兹·德墨忒尔的“虚空之语”只在该遗址尚未被发现时把它放到我们境内。
notes.en: Review note: the site has a spawn weight (30 on frozen worlds, 5 on cold habitable ones, max_instances = 1), so it can appear at galaxy generation; Nasuz Demetor's 'Voices in the Void' only places it in our space while it has not been found.

texts.zh:
我们的[owner.GetScientistPlural]在一座晶莹剔透的冻湖边扎营。由于光源充足，人们甚至可以看见冰面之下的幽魂之塔透出点点微光。它们自湖床向上延伸，仿佛坚实的卷须。

我们资历尚浅的探险队成员依然在如此刺骨、严苛的寒冷中不停地工作。尽管条件艰苦，我们的挖掘却进展的很顺利。我们已经发现了好几个气阀，都是为原始的水下舰艇而设计成的港口。然而，我们却没有在现场发现这些舰艇的踪影。不管这些高塔的住民是留下来还是逃走了，港口上都已经是空无一人。
texts.en:
Our [owner.GetScientistPlural] have set their camps around the edges of a glassy, frozen lake. Under sufficient light, one may catch glimpses of spectral towers underneath. They grasp upwards from the lake bed like steadfast tendrils.

Our less experienced crews are still adjusting to work in such biting, sterile cold. Despite this, our excavations have proceeded swiftly. We have exposed numerous airlocks, all designed for primitive submarine vessels. There is, as yet, no sign of the vessels themselves. Whether the tower's inhabitants stayed or fled, every one of its docks was left empty.

label.zh: 我们应当将资源进一步投入到破冰技术上。
label.en: We should invest further in these ice-breaking techniques.

texts.zh:
随着我们进一步从各种各样的冰层定居点上移走大冰块，我们的[owner.GetScientistPlural]在停泊塔处发现了一座原始的计算机终端。它那易碎的金属外壳看上去被……咬了个扎实。

这个终端在经过一些轻微的修理之后，顺利地启动了。定居点数据网络的大部仍然处于下线状态，但是我们可以从本地缓存中的股权证明、个人文件，还有一些看上去是任务日志的文件中推断出很多情报。
texts.en:
As we continue to remove large sections of ice from around the various icebound habitats, our [owner.GetScientistPlural] at the docking tower have discovered a primitive computer terminal. Its brittle metal casing appears to have been... chewed upon.

The terminal booted up correctly after some minor repairs. Large parts of the habitat's data network remain offline, but we can infer a great deal from local caches of stock manifests, personnel files, and what appears to be a stash of mission logs.

texts.zh:
我们对[from.planet.GetName]上古代定居点的知识愈发深刻，我们的忧虑也更加浓厚。我们之前发现的只是一处前哨殖民地的残垣——属于某个文明的遗迹，这个文明长久以来被世间遗忘，我们甚至都辨识不出他们的名字。

在这个星球，海洋占据着绝对主导的地位。各种不同团体的殖民者从母星被带到这个星球，应征成为水下先遣队成员。他们的目标：建立殖民地，开发这颗行星的自然资源。然而，他们的现实却是一场未加约束的生物学实验、剧烈的政治变动，以及凶猛的动植物带来的重大危险。

我们找到了一处导航浮标上面的传感器日志，看上去它记录了一组队员前往附近哨站的路线。我们相信这些人的舰艇仍然在原地，被困在冰层中，包含有许多有用的材料。
texts.en:
Our knowledge of the ancient settlement on [from.planet.GetName] deepens, but so too does our concern. What we have uncovered is the remains of a frontier colony - a remnant of a civilization so long forgotten, we cannot even discern their name.

When seas were a more dominant feature on this world, disparate groups of settlers were brought from their homeworld and conscripted into pioneer submarine crews. Their goal: to establish colonies and exploit the planet's natural resources. Their reality, however, was one of unchecked biological experiments, radical political change, and significant peril fending off hostile flora and fauna.

The sensor logs from a navigation buoy appear to have tracked one such crew en route to a nearby outpost. We believe their vessel may still be there, trapped in ice along with a cache of useful materials.

label.zh: 立刻派遣一支研究小队。
看看我们从这些剽悍的海洋住民身上能学到些什么。
label.en: See what we can learn about those hostile ocean-dwellers.

texts.zh:
这是一个被墨冰包围的洞穴，在里面我们发现了一艘瘫痪烧毁的古老潜艇残骸。这个烧焦的洞穴让残骸得以避开这颗星球上最为恶劣的冻融循环，将这群船员遭受灭顶之灾的惨状完好地保留了下来。

该潜艇落后的核引擎上有过紧急维修的迹象。在船员舱中，我们发现了划痕以及化学物质灼烧留下的微量残留。潜艇上所有的逃生仓当时都已派出，不过有一个被卡在了附近休眠的火山口中。

这艘残骸上可供收集的东西不多，但这群船员原先的目的地——一座殖民地补给仓库依旧完好无损。我们的维修团队因此得以将这群注定失败的船员无法修复的部件成功修复。
texts.en:
Blackened ice surrounds the cave in which we found the crumpled, burnt wreckage of an ancient submarine. Sheltered from the worst of this planet's freeze-thaw cycles, this scorched cave has preserved evidence of multiple calamities befalling this crew.

The vessel's crude nuclear engine bears signs of hasty patchwork repairs; in the crew quarters we found scratch marks and faint residue from chemical burns. At some point all the submarine's escape shuttles were deployed, yet only one remains nearby - it became lodged inside a dormant lava vent.

There is little more to glean from this burnt-out wreckage, but the crew's erstwhile destination - a colonial supply cache - has remained intact. Our recovery team has therefore succeeded in retrieving what the doomed submariners could not.

texts.zh:
我们在厚重的冰层中挖掘出了一条隧道，在一个密闭洞穴中找到了一艘潜艇的完整残骸。冻土带的环境将所有有机物都化为了齑粉，但是也让许多古迹完好保存下来。

我们的人类学研究表明，当船员们逃离附近的殖民地后，这艘潜艇便成了孕育了诸多政治活动的温床。它们在船舱内部各自划分了数个主权边界，并分别支持不同类型的政治主张。令人震惊的是，这种极端的派系划分不仅没有使船员分裂，反而加强了船员之间的社会联系。这个研究肯定会在我们的主攻政治学的科学家们引发激烈的讨论。
texts.en:
We have tunnelled through significant quantities of ice to find the intact wreckage of a submarine, sealed within an airtight cave. Tundral conditions have long since reduced all organic matter to fine dust, but so too have they preserved a wealth of cultural artifacts.

Our anthropological survey suggests a hotbed of political activity as this submarine's crew broke away from the nearby colony. They proclaimed several sovereign boundaries within the hull of their own submarine, espousing all manner of political ideologies. Surprisingly, this extreme factionalism appears to have strengthened the social bonds of this crew rather than forcing them apart. The matter is sure to spark lively debate amongst our own political scientists.

label.zh: ……让我们比不同政见者更进一步。
label.en: ... Keeping us one step ahead of dissidents.

label.zh: ……让我们比不同政见者更进一步。
label.en: ... Keeping us one step ahead of dissidents.

texts.zh:
我们本以为如此古老的遗骸在漫长的岁月中早已被破坏，谁知道由于当时的急速冻结，保护了遗骸的上半部分。随之一起保存下来的还有许多生物的尸体，其中一些貌似是当地的巨大又凶猛的捕食性动物。其他穿着防护服的智慧生物似乎是那些猎食者的猎物。

这些潜艇上的船员并不是[fromfrom.planet.GetName]本地人。我们的解剖表明，他们将当地生物的基因拼接融入到自己体内。至于这群殖民者为什么要这样广泛地进行自我改造，恐怕我们只能自己想象了。但不可否认的是，他们利用这种方式，确实让这些基因得以保存下来。
texts.en:
We had expected such an ancient wreck to have been crushed long ago. Instead we find that this stricken hulk was flash-frozen, preserving its superstructure along with the corpses of numerous creatures. Some of these appear to have been native fauna: large, ferocious and decidedly predatory in nature. The others appear to have been their prey: a small group of sapient beings wearing environment suits.

These individuals - the submarine's crew - did not originate on [fromfrom.planet.GetName]. Rather, our autopsy suggests that these aliens had gene-spliced themselves with material from local lifeforms. We can only imagine what drove the colonists to modify themselves so extensively, and yet we cannot deny: by preserving this genetic material within themselves, they have ensured the survival of a valuable genetic history.

texts.zh:
在尽我们所能调查了潜艇残骸和废弃居住区后，我们在[from.planet.GetName]的队伍正准备于行星地表附近重整。这里的殖民地尚有太多未知。我们找到的东西大多只相当于五花八门的遗物，它们的原主人曾在格外孤独、边远的地方生活。

尽管缺少超光速旅行的能力，这些古代潜艇居民们引导我们在其他领域取得了可观的突破。他们经历艰险取得了这些发现，我们会力求不再经历诸如此类的磨难。
texts.en:
Having surveyed all we can from the wrecked submarine and abandoned habitats, our teams on [from.planet.GetName] are preparing to regroup near the planet's surface. There is much we still do not know about this colony. Most of what we found simply amounts to an eclectic legacy, of life on a particularly lonely frontier.

Although they lacked faster-than-light travel, these ancient submariners have steered us towards remarkable breakthroughs in other fields. They made these discoveries in hardship, the likes of which we can strive not to experience ourselves.

texts.zh:
在尽我们所能调查了潜艇残骸和废弃居住区后，我们在[from.planet.GetName]的队伍正准备于行星地表附近重整。这里的殖民地尚有太多未知。我们找到的东西大多只相当于五花八门的遗物，它们的原主人曾在格外孤独、边远的地方生活。

尽管他们的文明尚未拥有超光速旅行技术，磨难艰险似乎引导这个一度位于潜艇内的殖民地在科学和经济上取得了独特的突破，我们如今可以随意利用这些发现。
texts.en:
Having surveyed all we can from the wrecked submarine and abandoned habitats, our teams on [from.planet.GetName] are preparing to regroup near the planet's surface. There is much we still do not know about this colony. Most of what we found simply amounts to an eclectic legacy, of life on a particularly lonely frontier.

Although their civilization did not yet possess faster-than-light technology, hardship seems to steered this once-submarine colony towards some singular breakthroughs in science and economics, which we are now at liberty to exploit.

label.zh: 这些警世通言也许会让我们的殖民者受益。
label.en: These cautionary tales may benefit our colonists.

label.zh: 地下居住地是个有趣的主意。
label.en: Sub-surface habitats are an interesting idea.

label.zh: 我们可以好好利用潜艇上的军备。
label.en: We could put that submarine's armaments to good use.

label.zh: 我们一定要珍惜他们的回忆。

texts.zh:
首席考古学家[leader.GetName]最近变得越来越孤僻。[leader.GetHeSheCap]像是对研究项目越来越漠不关心，反而沉迷于那些迄今为止发现的所有日记与日志。[leader.GetHeSheCap]还总是嘟囔着：“这些人该有多孤独啊。”

这也许是荒凉的挖掘现场的造成的负面影响。我们可以为整个小队提供一下心理咨询，或者相信[leader.GetName]，让[leader.GetHisHer]在工作中想出解决方法。
texts.en:
Chief archaeologist [leader.GetName] has been growing steadily more withdrawn of late. [leader.GetHeSheCap] appear[leader.GetSXX] less invested in our research goals, choosing instead to obsess over the various diaries and logs we have uncovered so far. [leader.GetHeSheCap] often mutter[leader.GetSXX] about "how lonely these people must have been".

It is possible the bleakness of this dig site is taking a toll. We can arrange for team-wide counseling, or else trust that [leader.GetName] finds resolution in [leader.GetHisHer] work.

label.zh: 安排一下，队员的健康最为重要。
label.en: Make arrangements. Our team's health is of utmost importance.

label.zh: 让[leader.GetHimHer]去吧，说不定[leader.GetHeShe]真的发现了什么呢。

texts.zh:
首席考古学家[absconded_archaeologist.GetName]现在不知所踪，随[absconded_archaeologist.GetHimHer]一同消失的还有一大批人类学数据。队员汇报称一辆地面载具失踪，不过我们的保护服还留在基地里。

[absconded_archaeologist.GetName]有可能跑到冻土带的另一处潜艇居住地去了。不过出于实际考虑，我们必须做好最坏的打算。
texts.en:
Chief archaeologist [absconded_archaeologist.GetName] has absconded, taking a sizeable portion of our anthropological data with [absconded_archaeologist.GetHimHer]. The team reports one ground vehicle missing, but all our environment suits remain at the base.

It is possible [absconded_archaeologist.GetName] escaped to another submarine habitat somewhere across the tundra, but realistically... We must assume the worst.

texts.zh: 考古学家[leader.GetName]付出了惨重的代价。尽管大家看上去相当疲惫，但[leader.GetHeShe]还是重新回到了团队之中，并提出了一个令人信服的猜想。我们似乎忽略了几个个人文件汇总中的微妙细节。总之，这些线索将协助我们，带来团队一直期望的突破。
texts.en: A heavy toll has been exacted upon archaeologist [leader.GetName]. Though they appear quite haggard now, [leader.GetHeShe] has rejoined the team and presented a compelling hypothesis. It seems we had overlooked several subtle details in the corpus of personal documents. Together, these clues provide just the sort of breakthrough we had been hoping for.

label.en: But was it worth the cost?

texts.zh:
[fromfrom.planet.GetName]的发掘小队正紧跟着[owner.capital_scope.GetName]上[owner.GetResearchers]的工作步伐，尝试着用各种新方法挖掘坚固的冻土层。地面团队已经部署了一台原型挖掘机，其设计很大程度上参考了环境改造技术。

早期试验表明，这台机器将迅速推进我们的工作进程。不过，团队成员已经发现了一些风险。如果我们要尝试控制风险，则需要拨付额外的资金。
texts.en:
The excavation team on [fromfrom.planet.GetName] has been working closely with our [owner.GetResearchers] on [owner.capital_scope.GetName], trying out novel solutions for work in harsh tundra. The ground team has deployed a prototype excavator whose design draws heavily on terraforming techniques.

Early trials suggest this machine will significantly speed up our work here. However, they have identified several risks. Additional funds will be required if we are to try and mitigate those.

summary.text:
# 冰封之下 / Under the Ice

- 分类 Category：先驱者与考古 C2 precursors · 来源 Sources：common/archaeological_site_types/00_base_game_arc_sites.txt:362–426、events/arcsite_events.txt:14–580、events/arcsite_random_events.txt:14–200、common/scripted_effects/archaeology_event_effects.txt:1115 起、events/paragon_events_4.txt:3703–3808 · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12（部分 partial）

## 如何开始 How it starts

考古遗址“冰封之下”位于冰冻或寒冷的星球，全银河最多一处。它可在星系生成时出现（冰冻星球权重30，寒冷宜居星球5），也可由知名领袖纳苏兹·德墨忒尔的“虚空之语”在我方寒冷星球上创建（仅当遗址尚未被发现时）。发掘需要带科学家的舰队。
A single dig site on a frozen or cold world: it can generate with the galaxy or be created by Nasuz Demetor's *Voices in the Void* (only while unfound). Excavation needs a fleet led by a scientist.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. “灵异螺旋塔”（1000）：冰湖下的古老水下聚落。
2. “磨损与撕裂”（1005）。
3. “令人不安的进展”（1010）：派研究队，或研究敌对的海洋生物（后者记录 ocean_tech 标记）。
4. 第四阶段由隐藏事件1015等权三选一：“火与水”（1016，合金）、“潜艇内的主权”（1017，凝聚力/社会研究，威权与平等帝国另有加成）、“基因传承”（1018，基因科技进度）。
5. “冰封磨难”（1020）：按前面的发现与国策选择殖民经济修正、深层天坑或质量投射器科技等奖励。
Five stages; stage 4 is one random result of three; the final event offers rewards depending on earlier finds and civics.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 1016/1017/1018 互斥，不是先后三章；地图中三者串成一线是编译器的已知问题。
  The three stage-4 results are exclusive; their chain on the map is a known compiler issue.
- 掷骰失败时可能触发通用发掘事件（陷阱、资源、争吵、疾病、故障、幻象，收录在共享故事中）或本遗址专属的“孤独守夜人”（9000 → 9001 叛逃 / 9002 归队，各50%）与“破冰器”（9005，需相关科技或水生天赋）。
  Failed rolls can trigger generic dig incidents or the site-specific *Lonely Vigil* and *Icebreaker*.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 排外帝国、进化掠食者起源、纪念主义与几种企业国策在1018/1020有专属选项。
  Xenophobes, Evolutionary Predators, memorialists and some megacorp civics get their own options.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：遗址定义、阶段事件、1015 的分派与排除条件、掷骰失败效果中的权重（9000/9005各50，共160）及9000的后续。
- 更正 Corrections：该遗址原被并在“兹泰格·迈尔的宝藏”故事中；它是独立的考古遗址，现单列，并由纳苏兹·德墨忒尔的故事链接到这里。
- 不确定 Uncertain：编译器的阶段串联问题未修复前，状态为部分。
